mentions.name: Sports similarity explorer
mentions.description: A sports data site that shows which games playing today are most similar to in the history of the sport, with clickable drill-downs. It includes a 'Sports Zodiac' feature and a 'Play the Years' timeline visualization that makes historical eras like the war years, lockouts, and the pandemic easy to see in the data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I like sports! I like data! Combine!

This lets you see what the games on today are most similar to in the history of the sport. Click into one and see.
